lines.text: After three days without finding water, Moses cast a log into Marah's bitter water, and it became sweet.
The people camped by twelve springs at Elim, then grumbled against Moses and Aaron in the Desert of Sin.
The glory of the LORD appeared in a fire, and that evening quail came and covered the camp.
Manna kept until morning got maggots, but on the seventh day the manna set aside had none.
Aaron placed a jar of manna in front of the Testimony, and the Israelites ate manna for forty years.
